decision.summary: Two regions stand out: (1) a sharp multi-sample offset near index 489–492 across all axes, possibly a temporary displacement or jump; (2) a prolonged accelerating drift with superimposed jumps from index 605 to end, lacking any clear reversal or platform phase. Other intervals show noisy but ordinary motion.

regions.observation: Sharp multi-sample drop in N and E components around index 489–492, with U showing a concurrent rise; appears as an abrupt offset rather than smooth motion. Preceded by relatively stable behavior and followed by continued drift—suggests possible temporary offset or jump.

Sustained accelerating trend in N (positive), E (negative), and U (negative) from ~index 605 onward, with increasing amplitude and no clear return; includes several large jumps (e.g., at 610, 620, 630) superimposed on monotonic drift—ambiguous whether platform-like or cumulative permanent shifts.
